# DAPS

## Deterministic Approximation of Posteriors

`DAPS` is an R package implementing the **DAP-S** (Deterministic
Approximation of Posteriors) algorithm for Bayesian genetic
fine-mapping. DAP-S combines the computational efficiency of SuSiE’s
variational approximation with the accuracy and interpretability of
Bayesian Variable Selection Regression (BVSR) model using the DAP
framework.

The method provides a **fast, scalable, and well-calibrated** approach
for identifying causal genetic variants and constructing **interpretable
signal clusters**, which enable flexible construction of credible sets.

## Installation

``` r
# install the package via devtools
install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("wnbo9/DAPS")
# load the package
library(DAPS)
```

## Vignettes

See the [vignettes](https://wnbo9.github.io/DAPS/articles/index.html)
for a quick start and worked examples.

## Dependencies

`DAPS` requires R (\>= 4.0.0), susieR (\>= 0.15.0), Rcpp (\>= 1.1.0),
RcppArmadillo, Matrix, Rfast, ggplot2 and patchwork.

We recommend running `DAPS` with an optimized BLAS library, such as
**OpenBLAS**, **Intel MKL**, or **Apple’s Accelerate framework**, which
can be substantially faster than the reference BLAS shipped with R.
Check your BLAS:

``` r
sessionInfo()   # see the "BLAS:" and "LAPACK:" lines
```

A quick benchmark: an elapsed time of about 1 second or less suggests an
optimized BLAS is in use.

``` r
m <- 5000
A <- matrix(rnorm(m^2), m, m)
system.time(A %*% A)
```

# Package index

## Package Functions

- [`daps()`](https://wnbo9.github.io/DAPS/reference/daps.md) : DAP-S
  fine-mapping with individual-level data
- [`daps_ss()`](https://wnbo9.github.io/DAPS/reference/daps_ss.md) :
  DAP-S fine-mapping with sufficient statistics
- [`daps_rss()`](https://wnbo9.github.io/DAPS/reference/daps_rss.md) :
  DAP-S fine-mapping with regression summary statistics
- [`daps_plot()`](https://wnbo9.github.io/DAPS/reference/daps_plot.md) :
  DAP-S PIP plot with cluster / credible-set annotation
- [`daps_main()`](https://wnbo9.github.io/DAPS/reference/daps_main.md) :
  DAPS main function in Rcpp
- [`daps_ss_main()`](https://wnbo9.github.io/DAPS/reference/daps_ss_main.md)
  : DAPS_SS main function in Rcpp
- [`get_set()`](https://wnbo9.github.io/DAPS/reference/get_set.md) :
  DAP-S fine-mapping getting signal clusters or credible sets
